title: go.mod's go directive is now 1.24.2, dragged by fang's requirement
description:
Pinning fang v1.0.0 (tick nwj) required raising the module's go directive from 1.24.0 to 1.24.2 and bumping several indirect charmbracelet dependencies (cellbuf v0.0.15 and friends) to resolve an ansi API conflict with bubbletea v1.3.5's older pin. Any toolchain older than 1.24.2 can no longer build the module; if CI or another environment pins a Go toolchain explicitly, it should be checked against this floor.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 6721b3cacde6ff8b433d22c3d0b38054705d42296f11f5efe67e8487f5569a56 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-nwj/attempt-1): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates the done, naming no single item (the fallback names every item at risk in its reason). The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/6721b3cacde6ff8b433d22c3d0b38054705d42296f11f5efe67e8487f5569a56.json on the run branch.
